title.en: Summarise a study for the study group
title.es: Resumir un estudio para el grupo de estudio

es: Resumir un estudio sencillo ante el grupo con registro académico: objetivo, método, resultado, una pasiva impersonal y una respuesta prudente a una duda.

teaching.en: It is widely assumed that teenagers need more sleep than adults.
teaching.es: Se da por sentado que los adolescentes necesitan dormir más que los adultos.
teaching.explanationEs: Pasiva impersonal: It is + participio + that + oración; presenta una opinión general sin decir quién la sostiene.
segments: It is widely assumed that teenagers
teaching.audioText: It is widely assumed that teenagers need more sleep than adults.

teaching.en: It has been shown that later start times improve attention.
teaching.es: Se ha demostrado que una hora de inicio más tardía mejora la atención.
teaching.explanationEs: Con el presente perfecto se escribe It has been shown (con been): es un resultado ya establecido.
teaching.audioText: It has been shown that later start times improve attention.

teaching.en: The effect is thought to be small, so the conclusion is tentative.
teaching.es: Se piensa que el efecto es pequeño, así que la conclusión es provisional.
teaching.explanationEs: Variante personal: sujeto + be + participio + to + verbo; muy frecuente con thought, believed y expected.
segments: The effect is thought to be
small, so the conclusion is tentative.
teaching.audioText: The effect is thought to be small, so the conclusion is tentative.

teaching.en: It is difficult to generalise from one school to all schools.
teaching.es: Es difícil generalizar de un colegio a todos los colegios.
teaching.explanationEs: Generalise marca el límite del estudio: lo encontrado en una muestra no vale automáticamente para todos.
segments: It is difficult to generalise from
teaching.audioText: It is difficult to generalise from one school to all schools.

teaching.en: Overall, the study suggests a modest benefit for students.
teaching.es: En conjunto, el estudio sugiere un beneficio modesto para los estudiantes.
teaching.explanationEs: Overall abre la conclusión y resume varios resultados en una sola idea.
teaching.audioText: Overall, the study suggests a modest benefit for students.

teaching.en: Briefly, the aim was to compare two groups of students over eight weeks.
teaching.es: Brevemente, el objetivo era comparar dos grupos de estudiantes durante ocho semanas.
teaching.explanationEs: Briefly introduce un resumen rápido: objetivo y método en una sola frase.
segments: Briefly, the aim was to compare two
groups of students over eight weeks.
teaching.audioText: Briefly, the aim was to compare two groups of students over eight weeks.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se ha demostrado que dormir ayuda a la memoria.»

feedback.es: La pasiva impersonal de resultado establecido es It has been shown that…

origin.text: It has been ___ that sleep helps memory.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es una pasiva impersonal bien formada?

choices.text: Is thought that the effect is small.
It thinks that the effect is small.
It is thought that the effect is small.

feedback.es: La pasiva impersonal necesita el sujeto it y be + participio.

hint.es: En inglés la oración siempre necesita sujeto.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Brevemente, el objetivo era comparar dos grupos.»

answer.text: Briefly, the aim was to compare two groups
accepted: Briefly, the aim was to compare two groups
Briefly the aim was to compare two groups

feedback.es: Briefly abre un resumen rápido; después van el objetivo y el método.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué concluye el hablante.

choices.text: The benefit is small and may not apply to other classes.
The benefit is large and applies to every class.
There is no benefit at all.

feedback.es: Overall resume en «a small benefit», y «only one class» marca el límite de la muestra.

origin.audio: Overall, the study suggests a small benefit, but the sample came from only one class.

prompt.es: Te preguntan si el resultado vale para todos. ¿Qué respuesta es prudente?

choices.text: The result applies to all classes without doubt.
It is difficult to generalise from one class to all classes.
It is shown that every class is the same.

feedback.es: La respuesta prudente reconoce que una sola clase no permite generalizar.

prompt.es: Completa: «En conjunto, los alumnos se concentraron mejor.»

feedback.es: Overall resume los resultados en una conclusión general.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase condensa «Schools adopted the method, and errors fell a lot»?

choices.text: The adoption of the method led to a significant increase in errors.
The method led to a significant adoption in errors.
The adoption of the method led to a significant reduction in errors.

feedback.es: Adoption y reduction condensan los dos verbos y mantienen el sentido.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los resultados son provisionales porque solo cubren ocho semanas.»

feedback.es: Tentative valora unos resultados provisionales por su corta duración.

origin.text: The results are ___ because they cover only eight weeks.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué postura tienen los autores.

choices.text: They are cautious and ask for more research.
They are certain and need no more research.

feedback.es: Suggest, modest y further research is needed muestran una postura cauta.

origin.audio: It is thought that the effect is small. The authors suggest a modest benefit, but they admit that further research is needed.

prompt.es: Resume el estudio: objetivo, método, resultado, pasiva impersonal y respuesta cauta.

answer.text: The aim of this study was to examine whether daily walking improves memory. Briefly, two hundred adults were followed for six weeks, and half of them walked thirty minutes a day. Overall, the people who walked scored eight per cent higher on a memory test. It is often assumed that exercise helps memory, and these findings suggest a modest benefit. However, all the participants were volunteers, so it is difficult to generalise the results to everyone. To answer your question, we cannot say that exercise improves memory for all people. Further research is needed, and for now the conclusion is tentative.
accepted: The aim of this study was to examine whether daily walking improves memory. Briefly, two hundred adults were followed for six weeks, and half of them walked thirty minutes a day. Overall, the people who walked scored eight per cent higher on a memory test. It is often assumed that exercise helps memory, and these findings suggest a modest benefit. However, all the participants were volunteers, so it is difficult to generalise the results to everyone. To answer your question, we cannot say that exercise improves memory for all people. Further research is needed, and for now the conclusion is tentative.

This study examined whether walking every day improves memory. Two hundred adults took part for six weeks, and half of them walked for thirty minutes a day. The people who walked scored 8% higher in a memory test. It is believed that exercise helps memory, and the findings suggest a small benefit. However, the participants were all volunteers, so we cannot say that the result applies to everyone. To answer your question, it is difficult to generalise from this group. Further research is needed, so the conclusion is tentative.

feedback.es: Un buen resumen recorre objetivo, método y resultado, incluye una pasiva impersonal y responde con cautela al límite de la muestra.

origin.text: Estudio: ¿caminar cada día mejora la memoria? 200 adultos durante seis semanas; la mitad caminó 30 minutos al día. Los que caminaron puntuaron un 8 % más en una prueba de memoria. Todos eran voluntarios. Un compañero pregunta: «¿Podemos asegurar que el ejercicio mejora la memoria?» Escribe el resumen (objetivo, método y resultado), usa una pasiva impersonal y responde con cautela.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Se cree ampliamente que el efecto es pequeño.»
